scope: Four direct paired batches: B37->inline, R0->inline, and two integrated->inline rounds. All 20 inputs use the revised manifest. Historical denominators are direct, not products of separate ratios. The inline build is a separate annotation experiment, not integrated into the main branch.
sampling_limit: Sampling continued with known same-host concurrent work by user authorization. Whole-process wall/cycles are observations, not a timing or V8 Score admission decision.
statistics: Per side, eight independent process samples; median/min/max and population CV=100*pstdev/mean. right/left ratio uses side medians. /usr/bin/time -l covers process startup, JS compilation, execution, and teardown.

checks.rss_threshold_rule: max(3% of left median maximum_resident_set_size, 1 MiB)

fixed-final-b37.counter_scope: whole process including startup and teardown

fixed-final-r0.counter_scope: whole process including startup and teardown

fixed-inline-1.counter_scope: whole process including startup and teardown

fixed-inline-2.counter_scope: whole process including startup and teardown
